basic_info.description: Updated 2 bedroom, 2 bath top floor condominium in well maintained complex with only 12 units. Large, sound proofed windows (removable) makes this home unexpectedly quiet and serene. 5+ Skylights for incredible natural light throughout the day. This home feels like a tranquil respite from hub bub of San Francisco. Refinished hardwood floors, brand new carpet in bedrooms, bathrooms with custom fixtures, granite kitchen countertops, newer appliances, fireplace in combination living/dining room - the list keeps going! Separate, enclosed deeded garage with huge storage capacity or additional office. Convenient location in sought after lower Pacific Height location with easy access to some of the best retail/restaurants in the world! Lafayette Park 3 blocks away. Just voted one of the top 10 most desirable zip codes in America!
